messages:
Alex: FYI we need an accelerator + networking lift for a new APAC tenant (VEGA). Account 123456789012. Target regions: ap-northeast-8 primary, ap-southwest-4 secondary.
Mira: numbers? timeframe?
Alex: Requesting p5.48xlarge x6, g5.48xlarge x12, p4d.24xlarge x2. ENI/IP ceiling bump to support ~60 extra ENIs. Start window: 2026-04-05 for initial pilot, steady state by 2026-04-12.
Sam: Are these Dedicated pools or shared? AZ distribution?
Alex: Dedicated pools (reserved for VEGA). Spread across 3 AZs in ap-northeast-8, failover to ap-southwest-4 if capacity constrained. Initial burst: 12 g5 for first 14 days.
Jordan: Do we need public IPs or NAT? Egress bandwidth concerns?
Alex: No public IPs on instances — private ENIs and NATGW egress. Need Elastic IP pool increase to 20 for NATGW HA and an ask to raise NATGW throughput limits for that account.
Mira: Can you paste a short justification for the AWS request? will attach to the support case.
Alex: Justification: VEGA is a realtime inference customer with strict latency SLOs for APAC enterprise users. We need reserved capacity to guarantee p50 < 80ms for streaming LLM inference. Workload is bursty (autumn campaign) so initial pilot needs immediate burst capacity then ramp to steady reserved pool. Expected sustained vCPU/GPU hours ~120k/mo. Will pay committed monthly for dedicated pool.
Sam: Any fallback routing if AWS entitlement delayed?
Alex: Yes — plan B is routing traffic to eu-west-3 (reduced latency for some traffic) and enabling cross-region model fallback. Also can spin up smaller g5.xlarge fallbacks if quota not ready.
infra-bot: Created AWS support case: 987654321. Suggested path: entitlement bump + ENI raise via TAM escalation. Estimated turnaround 3-7 business days after TAM engagement.
quota-bot: Note: p5 and p4d entitlement increases often need org-level approval. Please provide expected sustained monthly spend and a signed commit if available.
Jordan: Who's owning the AWS escalation and paperwork?
Alex: I'm owning the escalation. Action items: (1) Alex -> open formal SAM + finance signoff (today) (2) Mira -> confirm AZ subnet CIDRs and size for placement (by EOD) (3) Sam -> prep onboarding runbook and fallback routing policies (tomorrow)
Mira: Confirmed — will attach subnet ranges and expected ENI tagging scheme.
Sam: I'll draft the fallback routing policy and cost estimate. rough monthly delta for reserved capacity ~ $145k/mo, plus NAT/EIP costs.
Alex: Thanks. If TAM asks for more detail, ping me. cc: Jordan for networking. :thumbsup:
